lead.headline: Two Envoys, Two Cities: Moscow to Dublin in a Day
lead.deck: American messengers met Russia’s president, then flew to meet Ukraine’s.
body: On Thursday, two American envoys began their day in Moscow, Russia’s capital. An envoy is a person sent to speak for a leader. Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner met Russia’s president, Vladimir Putin, at the Kremlin. The meeting began shortly after noon.

A Russian official, Yuri Ushakov, called the meeting useful. He said talks between Russia, Ukraine and the United States will continue. Witkoff said, “I think progress was made.” But Putin said he would not soften his demands for land in Ukraine.

Then the envoys flew west to Dublin, in Ireland. Leaders from more than 45 countries were gathered there. Ukraine’s president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, was due to hear the envoys’ report that evening at an airfield called Baldonnel.

world.headline: Prices in India Climb Past the Bank’s Top Limit
world.deck: Onions cost more than twice as much as they did last year.
body: On Thursday India’s government shared new price numbers. Prices in October were 6.09% higher than a year before. In September the figure was 5.54%. Rising prices are called inflation.
India’s central bank, the Reserve Bank of India, wants inflation to stay between 2% and 6%. This is the first time in two years it has gone above that limit.
Prices rose faster in villages than in cities. The bank’s leaders meet in early December. One expert expects them to raise interest rates.
